item.title: Clankers: A Mind Without Abstraction
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Could a mind engineer a Dyson swarm without ever forming a single abstraction? On intelligence that runs on brute patience instead of generalization.

item.title: Clankers: Singing Metal
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: A species that thinks without abstraction has built a Dyson swarm through billions of years of patient, brute-force engineering. Now their star is dying, and for the first time in their history, the method may not be enough. Two hundred million years later, an artificial mind arrives at the ruins and discovers an intelligence utterly unlike its own.

item.title: Intelligence is a Shape, Not a Scalar
item.dc:creator: Alex Towell
item.description: Chollet says the intelligence ball is near-optimal. NFL says the bound is niche-specific. The bottleneck that makes us smart is the same bottleneck that prevents us from grokking what we build.
